name: Renovate Robotics Rufus
specialisedFor: asphalt shingle installation on pitched roofs
summary: Cable-driven robot that hangs from anchors on a pitched roof and nails asphalt shingles; its US maker uses it only on its own roofing jobs.

germany.statusNote: No route for a German buyer. Renovate Robotics does not sell or lease Rufus: it uses the robot itself as a roofing subcontractor on homes in New Jersey and Pennsylvania, and leasing to US roofers is only a plan. Its website now promotes an invite-only robot for commercial roofers. Rufus is built for North American asphalt shingle roofs.

specs.label: Roof type
specs.conditions: flat, tile and metal roofs are out of scope

specs.label: Movement
specs.value: winch and cables on roof anchors, moves in X and Y like a gantry

notes: Works only on steep-slope roofs with asphalt shingles.
Anchors go on the roof after underlayment and ice-and-water shield; setting anchor points at the ridge adds time at the start of each job.
Goes on and off the roof with a ladder lift and photographs the finished roof.
Needs a ground team; flashing and finishing stay manual. Maker says it is designed to halve the labour needed.

evidence.task: Presented Rufus; voted favourite product by the show audience
